2124585171961974807.en_summary: A viewpoint on market dislocation from $WULF CEO. Quoted PaulBPrager: This has been a terrible market. Cost of capital, risk appetite, public market valuations have changed. What has not changed is demand for compute, scarcity of power to support it, or difficulty bringing large-scale data center online. Market is forcing people to look harder at differences between projects and developers. That’s a good thing.
2124585171961974807.zh_summary: 來自 $WULF CEO 對市場錯位的觀點。引用 PaulBPrager：這是一個糟糕的市場。資本成本、風險偏好、公開市場估值已改變。未改變的是對計算的需求、支持它的電力稀缺，或將大規模數據中心上線的困難。市場正在迫使人們更仔細地看待項目和開發商之間的差異。這是好事。

ticker_notes.WULF: CEO 認為需求與電力稀缺未變，市場錯位是機會

On AI market crash: Democratic position on SI buildout spooked investors in terms of slowing, hawkish Fed remarks, people believe may be making policy mistake if over-tighten, substantial tightening in financial conditions. On circular financing: No, as Nvidia continues to be fantastically profitable, near unlimited demand for chips worldwide. Chances of Jensen returning and improving AI sentiment have gone up materially with more support from Washington.
